summary: Every control in the Captions and Text sections now changes the captions on the canvas. Every caption colour is a swatch that opens the app's own colour picker, with None beside the eyedropper for a pill, glow, outline or plate.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Open a recording with speech, Add Captions, then pick the Captions layer in Edit mode.

try.do: Set Show to 3 words, Said to Dim and Coming to Hidden, and watch the caption on the canvas.
Click the swatch beside Glow under Current word and pick a colour in the picker.
Set Animation to Grow with bounce and turn on Shadow.
Open Pill's swatch and click the struck-through None square beside the eyedropper.
Press Command-Z: the pill comes back.
Press Space and watch the styled word play.
Make the panel as narrow as it goes and look at Timing.

evaluate: Is a bare swatch (no colour name beside it) enough to tell what each caption colour is?
Is None beside the eyedropper where you would look for switching a glow or pill off?
Does every change show on the canvas the moment you make it?
At the narrowest panel, do the Timing arrows without words still read as Earlier and Later?
rough: What the user reported (dead dropdowns) was the invisible click target fixed just before this task. Once that was in, every look value already reached the canvas.
A colour lands when you let go of the picker's square or slider, not while you drag, because captions have no live preview path yet.
The picker covers the rows below the well it opened from, as it does for Appearance.
The caption words walk (caption-words-pop-walk) still stops before the panel because a recording now opens in View mode. Another open task owns that.
